workflow_description: Categorise these bank transactions into one of: Income, Office Expense, Travel, Subscriptions, Refund, Uncategorised. Use vendor name patterns in the description, fall back to counterparty if present. Negative amounts are refunds (always tag as Refund). Match case-insensitively. The output should keep all input columns and add 'category' (one of the six enum values) and 'rule_matched' (a trace string).
